skills.name: functional-requirements
skills.description: Exhaustive functional decomposition, user roles, domain workflows, business logic rules, input validation constraints, and traceability keys [REQ-XX].

skills.name: non-functional-quality
skills.description: Measurable quality attributes, latency thresholds (<200ms API, <1s page load), responsive layout across mobile and desktop, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), and fault recovery.

skills.name: security-architecture
skills.description: OWASP Top 10 defenses, session and cookie hardening (HttpOnly, SameSite), RBAC/ABAC authorization at data and API boundaries, input sanitization, rate limiting, and data encryption.

skills.name: diagram-crafting
skills.description: Semantic visual Mermaid diagrams (System Context, Component, Sequence, ERD, User Flow) paired with plain-language step-by-step narrative explanations for non-technical clients.

skills.name: living-srs-sync
skills.description: Treats the SRS as the living parent document of the software; synchronizes planner routes, design tokens, prototype screens, built code, and QA evidence for 100% equivalence.

skills.name: prototype-flow-capture
skills.description: Validates the HTML prototype navigation flow, executes parallel headless screenshot capture, and enriches the living SRS with visual screen evidence and tested user pathways.

skills.name: wireframe-generation
skills.description: Draws one application screen as a Low-Fidelity / Mid-Fidelity wireframe in classic Balsamiq / Figma blueprint style - strictly monochrome, crossed-box image placeholders, realistic sample data - as sections that drop into the studio's own wireframe shell.
